description: Scheduling; check-in; reviewing the chart; documenting visits; orders and results; clinical photos
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergy; medication and problem lists unavailable); 12 visits and about $900 revenue per clinic day; RPO set by the EHR vendor's backups
source_evidence: EV-030 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-020 (visit volume); EV-019 (revenue); EV-024 (vendor RPO)
manual_workaround: Printed next-day schedule and paper visit notes entered in the EHR after recovery; reschedule non-urgent visits

description: New prescriptions and refill requests sent to pharmacies through the EHR
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients can run out of chronic medications; pharmacies send refill requests daily
manual_workaround: Phone prescriptions to the pharmacy or paper prescriptions where state and federal law allow; pharmacy early-refill policies
dependent_people_or_facilities: Physician-owner (single point of failure; only prescriber)

description: Daytime calls; after-hours answering service; referral and records faxes; portal messages; texts to patients

dependent_third_parties: Answering service (no BAA); cloud fax vendor; phone carrier

description: Charge entry; claims submitted electronically by the billing company; payment posting

manual_workaround: Queue charges in the EHR/PM; billing company submits when restored; personal savings cover about one month of expenses
